newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firm at 483.25/484.25/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firm at 483.25/484.25/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firm, for the second day running, at 483.25/484.25 per dollar as TEM yields rose and investors sold dollars to take advantage of soaring interbank lending rates, traders said.
On Tuesday the unit closed at 484.00/485.00 per dollar.

Traders said Central Bank dollar sales into an already thin market only further punished the dollar as overnight interbank lending rates rose to between 35 and 80 percent from Tuesday's 15 to 40 percent level.
"A lot of banks were looking for bolivars," said one trader.
Yields on six month TEMs, used as a benchmark for wider interest rates, also rose nearly three points to 20.99 percent, further increasing the attractiveness of boliver holdings, traders said.
